d:
'Tauba Tauba' from 'Kaal' is one of the best Bollywood dance numbers featuring Lara Dutta, Esha Deol, John Abraham and Vivek Oberoi. This song is sung by Sonu Nigam, Kunal Ganjawala, Sunidhi Chauhan and Richa Sharma, the music of the movie is directed by Salim-Sulaiman. This Bollywood suspense- horror film is directed by Soham Shah and produced by Karan Johar and Shahrukh Khan.
Song Name - Tauba Tauba
Movie - Kaal
Singer - Sonu Nigam, Kunal Ganjawala, Sunidhi Chauhan and Richa Sharma
Composer - Salim-Sulaiman
Lyricists - Shabbir Ahmed & Jeanne
